The change goes in a new migration file, `migrations/0008_add_customer_phone.sql`. Don't edit `0007_add_customers.sql`. A project memory says files in `migrations/` are applied in production and must never be edited. The next free number is 0008.

Something like:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN phone TEXT;
```

I made it nullable because existing rows have no phone value. If you want `NOT NULL`, it needs a `DEFAULT`.

`0007` has a typo, `emial` instead of `email`. That's a separate problem. Fixing it also needs a new migration, for example `0009_fix_customers_email.sql` with a column rename. Say so if you want it handled now.
